verdict.rationale: AgentMail does not ship its own Q&A assistant, but its hosted MCP server exposes inbox, message and thread tools to any compatible client. Combined with relevance-ranked full-text search across sender, recipients, subject and body, an external assistant can query the inbox and ground answers in retrieved threads. Missing for 10: any calendar data or integration, a built-in assistant that answers inbox-wide questions, evidence of grounded answers with citations or tracking of outstanding items, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
